parts.note_add: Mazda 1758-19-020B is still sold new as the 79-83 RX-7 automatic flex plate (Atkins Rotary). The drive plate goes on over the A/T counterweight, positioned so the hole in the drive plate lines up with the counterweight as the factory figure shows, and both are held by the eccentric-shaft lock nut (see the flywheel/counterweight lock nut torque); mark plate and converter before separating them.

specs.item: Drive plate to torque converter bolts, tightening torque
specs.note: 25-36 ft-lb. The 1980 manual (S-045 7A:17, S-003 T:7) gives the same 3.5-5.0 m-kg.

specs.item: Drive plate to converter weight, tightening torque
Service tool: wrench for the converter-to-drive plate bolts
specs.note: Same tool number in the 1980 manual (S-045 7A section, removal step 16); no 1982 source seen. Mark the drive plate and converter before removal and realign the marks on refit.

specs.item: Replacement Atkins Rotary listing: counterweight to flexplate bolt, Mazda 9978-41-016
specs.note: Listed as 74-95 RX-7 rear counterweight to flexplate bolt, 5.10 USD at the time of reading; check it matches the bolts on the car.
